summary: The synthesis is well bounded and the main certificate is correct, but the implementation theorem currently omits a normalization required by Q. Two notation and scaling corrections are also needed before referee review.

findings.where: Voluntary migration model, Eq. (4), and Conditional implementation theorem
findings.issue: The paper asserts V_o(0)=0 although the displayed definition gives V_o(0)=-C_o(0); no assumption states C_o(0)=0. Q requires this normalization for its individual-rationality result, so the claimed equilibrium properties do not follow as written.
findings.fix: Assume explicitly that C_o(0)=0, or replace C_o(f_o) by C_o(f_o)-C_o(0), and carry that normalization into the theorem.

findings.issue: The origin conversion factor phi_o is used but only destination factors phi_j are defined.
findings.fix: Define a positive incremental electrical-demand factor for every origin and destination node, including phi_o.

findings.where: Forecast-error survival certificate, paragraph after the proposition
findings.issue: The regret bound omits the carbon weight rho if the shared objective is private cost plus rho times emissions, as in Eq. (4).
findings.fix: State the objectives explicitly and give the bound as rho D||e-hat e||_* when rho is present, or define the weighted coefficient vector before stating the bound.

summary: The synthesis is careful, mathematically sound in its main results, and fairly distinguishes the new construction from Q and P. A few local definitions and assumptions must be tightened before referee review.

findings.where: Voluntary migration model, Eq. (3) and Theorem 1
findings.issue: The meaning of c_{jt} is ambiguous because existing baseline electrical demand is not included in the shared constraint.
findings.fix: Define c_{jt} explicitly as residual capacity available for migrated workload, or subtract fixed baseline demand from total capacity.

findings.issue: The destination index does not exclude j=o, so a variable described as migrated work may represent work retained at its origin.
findings.fix: State j\ne o or explain how self-destination coordinates are treated.

findings.issue: Invoking all equilibrium properties of Q also requires Q's mechanism-specific conditions, including a valid multi-agent setting and feasible payment/LMI construction, not merely the displayed local-set and valuation conditions.
findings.fix: Explicitly condition the theorem on every mechanism-design hypothesis of Q, including N\geq2 and feasibility of its payment-parameter conditions.

findings.issue: The aggregate cost C(x) and feasible schedule set X appear without definitions connecting them to the earlier owner costs and flow variables.
findings.fix: Define C(x)=\sum_o[C_o(f_o(x))-C_o(0)] and define X before stating the regret bound.

summary: The paper is mathematically coherent, traceable to the note and ledger, and appropriately limits its new result to a conditional voluntary-migration model. It represents Q and P fairly, states the relevant limitations, and supports its cautious related-work claim with recorded searches. All bibliography entries are cited and have verified identifiers or URLs.
